1.1.0: Implemented multiselect input normalization for tools field.
1.1.2: Security: upgraded @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to 1.32.2 (DNS rebinding, ReDoS and cross-client data leak advisories).

Security: replaced the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-gitlab package (MCP SDK 1.0.1, zod 3) with a bundled server.js on MCP SDK 1.32.2. Same tools, input schemas, requests and output; responses GitLab returns in an unexpected shape (e.g. label names, null description) are no longer rejected with "Invalid arguments".
1.1.3: Security: with DEBUG enabled, the connecting-mcp-client and connected-mcp-client log steps no longer write the account credentials (the MCP server env) to the flow log; env values are masked.
